title: Service Contracts: when may a renewal offer be issued, and at which tier?
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product applies to a renewal offer: an offer on a trade lane on which the customer already has an active contract. It governs how early the renewal offer may be issued and whether the renewal can be at the same or a higher tier.

## Formal clause
A renewal offer on a lane with an active contract may be issued only from the tier's renewal notice period, in calendar days, before the current expiry date. It renews at the same or a higher tier only when the current contract lifted at least the tier's renewal performance percent of its commitment by the offer date; otherwise the renewal is offered one tier lower, or at the lowest tier whose band holds the new commitment.

## Condition, judgement, result
| Step | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Timing | Is the offer date within the renewal notice period before the current expiry date? | If it is earlier than that period, the renewal offer may not yet be issued. |
| Performance | By the offer date, has the current contract lifted at least the renewal performance percent of its commitment? | Yes: the renewal may be at the same or a higher tier. No: the renewal is offered one tier lower, or at the lowest tier whose band holds the new commitment. |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)
A current contract has a commitment of 1000 FEU and expires on 2026-12-31. Assume, for illustration only, a renewal notice period of 75 days and a renewal performance percent of 82.
- **Timing.** An offer dated 2026-11-15 is 46 days before expiry and lies inside the period. An offer dated 2026-09-01 is 121 days before expiry and is too early.
- **Performance level.** 1000 FEU multiplied by 82 and divided by one hundred gives 820 FEU.
- Lifted 830 FEU by the offer date: at least 820, so the renewal may be at the same or a higher tier.
- Lifted exactly 820 FEU: "at least" includes equality, so the renewal may still be at the same or a higher tier.
- Lifted 815 FEU: below 820, so the renewal is offered one tier lower, or at the lowest tier whose band holds the new commitment.

## Points of judgement
**Which volume counts?** The volume the current contract lifted by the date of the renewal offer, compared with the current contract's own commitment.

**Does a strong performance guarantee a higher tier?** No. Meeting the performance level only opens the same or a higher tier; it does not itself set the tier.
